drafts.text:
Is an outlet or light switch in your house warm to the touch?

That's not normal. It can mean a loose connection or an overloaded circuit.

Stop using it and have it checked by a licensed electrician.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165

Lights flicker when the AC or a big appliance kicks on?

A quick dip can be normal. Flickering that lasts, or happens all over the house, can point to a loose connection or a panel problem.

Worth a look before it gets worse.

SoLit Electric. 225-472-1165

Still have two-prong outlets in an older Baton Rouge home?

That usually means no ground wire. A three-prong adapter doesn't fix that.

Licensed master electrician Yancie David can tell you what your wiring needs.

SoLit Electric. 225-472-1165
